prediction: #433 HAKUX_POSTED_PUT=1 at the NFS MW race start on the full-switch base (REPORT_ASYNC + TEXSCAN + DRAWREC + UNI_BULK + UNI_UBERCACHE + UNI_FOGCACHE). On the REPORT_ASYNC + TEXSCAN base the posted store was taken on 12-32 % of kicks and moved nothing: the guest spent the lock wait it saved idle, and the PFIFO thread's own work (p_run) set the period, warm and cold. DRAWREC cuts the PFIFO thread's per-draw work (-21 % us/draw, drawrec1010), which shortens both the period's floor-setter and the time the PFIFO thread holds pfifo.lock. That could put the guest's store back on the path (the PFIFO thread waiting for the guest's next push), which is the case where posting helps; or it removes more of the lock hold the posted store would have skipped, leaving it less to take. The second is likelier: warm, A2' should sit within ~0.3 ms of the 33.5 ms vblank floor already, so no CPU lever can move the warm countdown by much; cold, the guest's lockw falls but cold start 1 is still PFIFO-paced. Point estimate: warm countdown A2' 33.8, B2' 33.8 (B - A 0.0, spread +-0.15); post-GO unchanged; cold start 1 B - A 0 +- 1.5 ms (one start per run); warm v2 share A2' ~82 %, B2' within +-3 points of it. Probabilities: P2 (B - A <= -0.5) ~7 %; F2 (B2' <= 33.8) ~40 %, mostly because A2' may already be there, so F2 says little about the store unless P2 also passes; C2 (cold B - A <= -2.0) ~12 %; H2 (v2 +10 points) ~5 %. What refutes it: P2 or C2 passing with '[postput] on' on B2' and every switch line on both arms. If C2 passes and P2 fails, the store helps only the cold start, where DRAWREC's shorter p_run made the guest's push the late one. Whatever the verdict, the recommendation is read from P (postput1010-nfs.json, failed), P2, F2 and C2 together: a store that passes none of P/P2/C2 is 'drop'.
expect_note: Named rules read by docs/lanes/postput1010/ppread.py --expect (legs V, P2, F2, C2, H2, in this order); a soak writes no captures. The brief's Addendum 1 checks, none loosened. An arm's figure is the mean of its two runs. P2: warm countdown B2' - A2' <= -0.5 ms. F2: B2' warm countdown <= 33.8 ms. C2: cold start 1, B2' - A2' <= -2.0 ms. H2: warm v2 share, B2' - A2' >= +10 points. V: each run 12 marks, >= 10 valid starts (raread.bad_starts), >= 10 warm pace lines, a g11 frame for every valid warm start, perflog off, the arm read from request.json env, '[reportasync] on', '[texscan] on', '[drawrec1010] drawrec=1 vtx=1 shc=1' and '[perdraw433] bulk=1 ubercache=1 fogcache=1' logged on every run and '[postput] on' on B2' only; and a moving car in the g11 frames, checked by eye and recorded in docs/lanes/postput1010/NOTES.md.
